product.name: VortexTech Titan 2TB SSD
product.description: The VortexTech Titan 2TB SSD is a high‑performance portable storage solution designed for professionals and creatives who demand speed and reliability. Encased in a lightweight aluminum shell, the drive delivers read speeds up to 550 MB/s and write speeds up to 520 MB/s, making large file transfers and backup operations swift. Its 2 TB capacity accommodates extensive media libraries, project files, and system backups. The Titan is compatible with USB 3.0 and USB 3.1 interfaces, supporting both Windows and macOS platforms without additional drivers. A built‑in 3‑year warranty and a sleek matte black finish make it a durable and stylish addition to any mobile workstation.
